How it works

## How Bespoke Fit works.

Live, 1-on-1 video coaching, every session. Here's exactly how it works, from sign-up to your first session and the weeks after.

1

### Sign up

Create your account, set up your profile, and activate your unlimited plan. Once your payment's set up, you book your onboarding call and plan the next steps.

2

### Onboarding call

You'll speak with our head coach to talk through your goals, your history, and what you want from your body and fitness.

3

### Meet your coach

We pair you with a coach based on your goals, personality, and schedule. We take great care to find the right fit, and if it's not right, you can switch anytime, no friction, no fee.

4

### Your program

Your coach builds your program around your equipment, your space, and the days you actually train. Home, smart gym, or full commercial setup, same coach, same care.

5

### Train live

Set your phone on a tripod or open a laptop webcam, pop in your AirPods, and join the video call. Your coach watches every rep and adjusts the load in real time.

- Live HD video
- 1-on-1
- Unlimited
- Every session

6

### Between sessions

Your coach is on the app any time for form checks, schedule swaps, and quick questions. Next week's program reflects what they saw this week, never templated.

7

### Track progress

Your strength, body composition, and session history land in your dashboard. Your coach reviews it weekly, and you adjust together based on what's working.

Coming soonApple Health and wearable sync

What this isn't.

- This isn't a generic app program.
- It's not AI.
- Nothing is ever pre-recorded.

It's a real human watching every rep, in real time, on a video call. Your coach sees your form, fixes it on the spot, and writes next week's program based on what they saw today.

![Carl, founder of Bespoke Fit](https://bespoke.fit/_next/image?url=%2Fimages%2Ffounder%2Fcarl-authentic.jpg&w=3840&q=75)

From Carl, founder

I've always been unsure what to do at the gym, and I didn't want to spend time figuring it out. Reddit said one thing. The trainer at the gym said another. Every fitness app said something different. So I set out to build a solution once and for all.

I built Bespoke Fit because I couldn't find what I wanted to buy. Apps can't correct your form. AI doesn't know you and won't keep you accountable. Local trainers cost over $90 an hour, and most can only see you twice a week. I couldn't afford that. The gap is obvious. So we built it.

A real coach on a live video call, watching every rep, writing every program, telling you exactly what to do. Priced so you can actually train three or four times a week without flinching.

Right now we're taking on 25 founding members, locked at $299 a month for life. After that, the rate moves to $499 for everyone else, and yours stays.

If this sounds like what you've been looking for, we'd love to have you join us.

![Carl J. Borg signature](https://bespoke.fit/_next/image?url=%2Fimages%2Ffounder%2Fsignature.webp&w=3840&q=75)
